y-m-28-13.title: Musiyano wemasquare enhamba mbiri odd dzinotevedzana nedzeven dzinotevedzana
y-m-28-13.goal: Siyanisa, uchishandisa mienzaniso nemitaurire ine mavariable, zvirevo zviviri zvechimiro chakafanana umo chimwe chinoshanda uye chimwe chisingashande, uye ugadzire wega mienzaniso inokodzera mamiriro.
y-m-28-13.material:
Mina: "Musiyano wemasquare enhamba mbiri odd dzinotevedzana imultiple ye8."
Seojin: "Musiyano wemasquare enhamba mbiri even dzinotevedzana uchavawo multiple ye8."
Mienzaniso inotsigira chirevo chaMina i3²−1²=8, 5²−3²=16, ne7²−5²=24. (3² inoverengwa se 'three squared'.)
y-m-28-13.thinking.0: Kutonga kana mienzaniso ichigona kuva humbowo hwechirevo chakasiyana
y-m-28-13.prereq.0: Kunyora nhamba dzeodd neeven nevariable (2n−1, 2n+1, nezvimwewo)
y-m-28-13.s.s1.prompt: Unoda kutonga chirevo chaSeojin (nezvenhamba dzeven) uchitarisa mienzaniso mitatu yaMina. Pfungwa ipi yakakodzera zvikuru?
y-m-28-13.s.s1.hint.0: Enzanisa padivi nedivi rudzi rwenhamba dzinotaurwa nechirevo chaSeojin nerudzi rwenhamba dzinotaurwa nemienzaniso yaMina.
y-m-28-13.s.s1.hint.1: Sarudza mapeya maviri kana matatu enhamba even dzinotevedzana uye uverenge musiyano wemasquare azvo zvakananga.
y-m-28-13.s.s1.o.a: Mienzaniso yenhamba odd haisi humbowo hwenhamba even, saka edza nenhamba even zvakananga
y-m-28-13.s.s1.r.a: Uku kutonga kunoda kuedza zvakananga nemienzaniso inokodzera nhamba dzinotaurwa nechirevo (odd/even).
y-m-28-13.s.s1.o.b: Zvakashanda kunhamba odd, saka zvichashandawo kunhamba even
y-m-28-13.s.s1.r.b: Nhamba odd neeven mapoka akasiyana enhamba. Kuva wakarurama kunhamba odd hakureve kuva wakarurama kunhamba even.
y-m-28-13.s.s1.o.c: Zvakashanda kunhamba odd, saka hazvizoshandi kunhamba even
y-m-28-13.s.s1.r.c: Kuva wakarurama kunhamba odd hakusi humbowo hwekuti haushande kunhamba even. Unofanira kuedza nenhamba even zvakananga.
y-m-28-13.s.s1.o.d: Pane mienzaniso mitatu chete, saka handigoni kuvimba nenzira ipi neipi, uye ndinomira kusvika ndatsanangura nemavariable
y-m-28-13.s.s1.r.d: Kutonga kwekuti mienzaniso mitatu humbowo hwakaneta uye kuti uchatsanangura nemavariable kunonzwisisikawo.
y-m-28-13.s.s1.explain: Chirevo chaSeojin chinoreva nhamba even, saka unofanira kuedza nemienzaniso yenhamba even (4²−2²=12, 6²−4²=20, 8²−6²=28). Makosha matatu aya haasi mamultiples e8. Kumira (d) uye kutsvaga chikonzero chakajairika nemavariable kana mienzaniso ichishomeka kunonzwisisikawo.
y-m-28-13.s.s1.acc.0: Kumira nokuti unoziva miganhu yemienzaniso mitatu uye unoda kushanda chikonzero chakajairika nemavariable kunonzwisisikawo.
y-m-28-13.s.s2.prompt: Rega a ive nhamba diki yenhamba mbiri odd kana even dzinotevedzana (a, a+2). Gadzira kukosha 4 kana kupfuura kwakasiyana kwe a kuti musiyano wemasquare (a+2)²−a² ive multiple ye8 kubva pa40 kusvika pa200. a inhamba yechisikigo kubva pa1 kusvika pa100.
y-m-28-13.s.s2.hint.0: Govanisa a kuita odd neeven uye uverenge (a+2)²−a² kune mashoma echimwe nechimwe.
y-m-28-13.s.s2.hint.1: Unganidza kukosha kwe a kwakapa mamultiples e8 uye utsvage zvavanogoverana.

y-m-28-13.s.s2.fail.c1: a inofanira kuva nhamba yechisikigo kubva pa1 kusvika pa100.

y-m-28-13.s.s2.explain: a=11→13²−11²=48, a=13→56, a=15→64, a=17→72, a=19→80. Dzose idzi dzine a odd uye dzinopa mamultiples e8. a=12 inopa 14²−12²=52, a=2 inopa 12 (pasi pe40), uye a=60 inopa 244 (pamusoro pe200), saka hadzishande.
y-m-28-13.s.s3.prompt: Rega nhamba mbiri odd dzinotevedzana dzive 2n−1 ne2n+1 (n inhamba yechisikigo) uye nhamba mbiri even dzinotevedzana dzive 2n ne2n+2, wana musiyano wemasquare, uye utsanangure kana imultiple ye8. Nyorawo kana chirevo chaSeojin chakarurama.
y-m-28-13.s.s3.hint.0: Wedzera masquare e2n+1 ne2n−1 uye uwane musiyano.
y-m-28-13.s.s3.hint.1: Ita kuverenga kumwe chete nenhamba even 2n+2 ne2n, uye uenzanise mugumisiro nemugumisiro wenhamba odd.
y-m-28-13.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora kutaura kwakawedzerwa chikamu nechikamu ukaratidza kuti n² inoparara here?
y-m-28-13.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakanyora nyaya yeeven se8n+4 ukataura kuti remainder kana ikagoverwa ne8 i4 here?
y-m-28-13.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakajekesa mhedziso yako kana chirevo chaSeojin chakarurama here?
y-m-28-13.s.s3.model.0: (2n+1)²−(2n−1)²=(4n²+4n+1)−(4n²−4n+1)=8n, saka imultiple ye8. Kunhamba even 2n ne2n+2, (2n+2)²−(2n)²=8n+4=4(2n+1), saka haisi multiple ye8. Chirevo chaSeojin hachina kururama.
y-m-28-13.s.s3.model.1: Kunhamba odd 2n−1 ne2n+1, musiyano i(2n+1+2n−1)(2n+1−2n+1)=4n×2=8n. Kunhamba even 2n ne2n+2, i(4n+2)×2=8n+4, saka remainder kana yagoverwa ne8 i4. Chirevo chaSeojin hachina kururama.
y-m-28-13.s.s3.modelNote.1: Mhinduro iyi yakaverengwa uchishandisa mugumisiro wehuwandu nemusiyano.

y-m-28-14.title: Kugadzira dambudziko rine mhinduro mbiri asi imwe chete ndiyo mhinduro

y-m-28-14.thinking.2: Siyanisa nyaya dzekurasa mhinduro nenyaya dzekushandisa zvose
y-m-28-14.s.s1.prompt: Kukosha kupi kunogona kushandiswa seupamhi hwemunda?
y-m-28-14.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora wega zvinotaurwa nemhinduro dzeequation nemamiriro enyaya.
y-m-28-14.s.s1.hint.1: Kana ukatora x=−8 seupamhi, verenga kuti kureba x+3 i chii.
y-m-28-14.s.s1.r.a: Makosha ose maviri anoita equation, asi unofanirawo kuongorora mamiriro enyaya ekuti x inomirira kureba.
y-m-28-14.s.s1.o.b: x=−8 ine absolute value huru, saka shandisa yakakura chete, x=−8, semhinduro
y-m-28-14.s.s1.r.b: Kureba kwakaipa hakuko mumamiriro enyaya. Mhinduro haisi iyo ine hukuru hwakakura.
y-m-28-14.s.s1.o.c: Pane mhinduro mbiri, saka dambudziko harina kururama
y-m-28-14.s.s1.r.c: Zvakajairika kuti quadratic equation ive nemhinduro mbiri. Dambudziko harina kuipa; unofanira kuenzanisa mhinduro nemamiriro.
y-m-28-14.s.s1.o.d: Shandisa x=5 chete. x=−8 haikodzeri nokuti kureba kwaizova kwakaipa
y-m-28-14.s.s1.r.d: Uku kutonga kunoongorora mhinduro dzeequation nemamiriro enyaya wega.
y-m-28-14.s.s1.explain: x iupamhi, saka inofanira kuva huru kupfuura 0. x=−8 inoita equation asi haisi mhinduro yedambudziko iri. Kureba i5+3=8 m uye nzvimbo i5×8=40 m².
y-m-28-14.s.s2.prompt: Panguva ino, gadzira dambudziko nenzira yakapesana. Kumunda une upamhi x nekureba x+k nenzvimbo A, gadzira (k, r, A) 3 kana kupfuura dzakasiyana umo upamhi inhamba yechisikigo r. k i kubva pa1 kusvika pa6, uye A i150 kana pasi.
y-m-28-14.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wasarudza upamhi r, wobva waverenga nzvimbo A kana kureba kuri r+k, uinyore.
y-m-28-14.s.s2.hint.1: Nyora dambudziko rawakagadzira sa x²+kx−A=0 uye uongorore kuti r imhinduro.
y-m-28-14.s.s2.ok.c1: k inhamba yechisikigo kubva pa1 kusvika pa6.
y-m-28-14.s.s2.fail.c1: k inofanira kuva nhamba yechisikigo kubva pa1 kusvika pa6.

y-m-28-14.s.s3.prompt: Sarudza rimwe pamadambudziko awakagadzira uye unyore kuti nei uchirasa imwe yemhinduro mbiri, uye upe muenzaniso wenyaya umo mhinduro dzose dzaizova mhinduro.
y-m-28-14.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora mhinduro mbiri dzedambudziko rawakagadzira, uye uverenge kana kureba nenzvimbo zvichikodzera kana ukatora imwe neimwe seupamhi.
y-m-28-14.s.s3.hint.1: Kudambudziko umo huwandu nemugumisiro wenhamba mbiri zvapiwa, fungidzira kuti mhinduro dzinofanira kuva dzei.

y-m-28-02.goal: Shandisa mamiriro ekuti nhamba iri pasi peradical isquare yenhamba imwe yechisikigo kuwana kukosha kwakawanda kwe n kunokodzera, uye utsanangure kuti kukosha uku kwe n kune chimiro chipi chavanogoverana.
y-m-28-02.material: Unoda positive square root √(24n) ye24 nguva nhamba yechisikigo n kuti ive nhamba yechisikigo. n inhamba yechisikigo kubva pa1 kusvika pa100. Semuenzaniso, kana n=1, √24 inenge 4.9, isiri nhamba yechisikigo. (√ inoverengwa se 'root'.)

y-m-28-02.prereq.1: Kunyora nhamba yechisikigo semugumisiro weprime factors
y-m-28-02.s.s1.prompt: Tanga wafunga. Ndeipi pazvinotevera iri kukosha kwe n umo √(24n) inhamba yechisikigo? (Tsvaga nhamba inova square yenhamba imwe yechisikigo kana yawanzwa ne24.)
y-m-28-02.s.s1.hint.0: Pasarudzo yega yega, wana kukosha mushure mekuwanza ne24 uye uriwenzanise ne1², 2², 3², ….
y-m-28-02.s.s1.hint.1: Ongorora kana kune sarudzo ine mugumisiro unoshaya nhamba yesquare nekungova pasi kana pamusoro payo.
y-m-28-02.s.s1.r.a: 24×2=48. Iri pakati pe6²=36 ne7²=49, saka haisi nhamba yesquare. Kuva padhuze ne7² hakuiti kuti ive nhamba yesquare.
y-m-28-02.s.s1.r.b: 24×12=288. Iri pasi pe17²=289, inosanganisa nyore, asi 288 haisi nhamba yesquare.
y-m-28-02.s.s1.r.c: 24×4=96. Iri pakati pe9²=81 ne10²=100, saka haisi nhamba yesquare. Zvinoita sekuti yaifanira kushanda nokuti 4 inhamba yesquare, asi 24 ine prime factor inoonekwa nguva dzeodd.
y-m-28-02.s.s1.r.d: 24×6=144=12². Nzira yekuwana n kuti mugumisiro uve nhamba yesquare yakashanda zvakanaka.
y-m-28-02.s.s1.explain: 24×6=144=12². 24×1 kusvika 24×5 i24, 48, 72, 96, 120, uye hapana nhamba yesquare pakati pazvo.
y-m-28-02.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira kukosha kwe n 3 kana kupfuura kwakasiyana, umo n inhamba yechisikigo kubva pa1 kusvika pa100 uye √(24n) inhamba yechisikigo.
y-m-28-02.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wasarudza n diki zvikuru inova nhamba yesquare kana yawanzwa ne24, wobva waedza nhamba dzaunogona kuwanza n iyoyo nadzo kuti irambe iri nhamba yesquare.
y-m-28-02.s.s2.hint.1: Enzanisa n yawakawana uchigovanisa kana kuwana maquotients, uye utarise pateni inoonekwa.

y-m-28-02.s.s2.fail.c1: n inofanira kuva kubva pa1 kusvika pa100.
y-m-28-02.s.s2.fail.c3: √(24n) haisi nhamba yechisikigo. Ongorora kana 24n isquare yenhamba imwe yechisikigo.
y-m-28-02.s.s2.explain: n=6→√144=12, n=24→√576=24, n=54→√1296=36, n=96→√2304=48. Dzose dzine chimiro che6×1², 6×2², 6×3², 6×4². n=150 inopawo √3600=60, asi iri pamusoro pe100, saka haienderani nemamiriro.
y-m-28-02.s.s3.prompt: Nhamba n dzine chimiro chipi? Nyora nemashoko ako kuti n dzawakawana dzinogoverana chii, uye nei, semuenzaniso, n=12 isingashande.
y-m-28-02.s.s3.hint.0: Wana quotient yen imwe neimwe yawakawana yakagoverwa ne6.
y-m-28-02.s.s3.hint.1: Kana n=12, verenga kuti 24×12 iri padhuze nesquare yenhamba yechisikigo ipi.
y-m-28-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakaongorora nenhamba kuti n dzawakawana dzose dzine chimiro chakafanana (6 nguva imwe nhamba) here?
y-m-28-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakatsanangura kuti nei n=12 isingashande uchishandisa kukosha chaiko kwe24×12 kana prime factors dzayo here?
y-m-28-02.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakaongorora kana zvichikwana kuti n ive multiple ye6 (semuenzaniso n=12) here?
y-m-28-02.s.s3.model.0: 24=2³×3=2²×6, saka 6 inosara. Saka n inofanira kuva 6 nguva nhamba yesquare kuti 24n ive nhamba yesquare. 6×1², 6×2², 6×3², 6×4² i6, 24, 54, 96. Kuna n=12, 24×12=288=2⁵×3², uye exponent 5 ye2 iri odd, saka haishande.
y-m-28-02.s.s3.model.1: Kuti nhamba ive nhamba yesquare, ma exponent ose eprime factors dzayo anofanira kuva even. Mu24=2³×3, ma exponent e2 ne3 ari odd, saka n inoda imwe 2 neimwe 3 zvakare. Saka n inofanira kuva 6×(nhamba yesquare), kwete chero multiple ye6, uye 12 (=6×2) haishande.
y-m-28-02.s.s3.modelNote.1: Unogonawo kutsanangura uchienzanisa 24×n zvakananga ne12², 24², nezvimwewo, pasina kushandisa prime factors.
